description:
We are looking for:

-Interested in building a QA culture

-Calm under pressure

-Analytical mindset

-Proactive attitude

-Ability to work independently

-General knowledge of business processes related to hospitals or pharmacy

-Experience in an IT consultant position

 

Work experience:

-Entry/middle level

 

Nice to have :

-Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related fields

-Experience with romanian healthcare system

-Basic SQL and API knowledge

 

It’s a plus

-Experience with Scrum Framework in Azure DevOps

 

What you’ll do :

You’ll be part of a QA team, working closely with our software engineers on proprietary systems within our Product Development team and will be held responsible for functional and non-functional manual tests. You will coordinate with the Product Owner, Technical Lead and our BA, QA Team Leader in understanding the functional and technical requirements, communicating with them regularly, raising any issues that arise on the project, and providing regular updates on projects.
